qy_common_pick_from_sidebar: Pick a section from the sidebar to get started.
qy_common_amount_hint: Amount is entered in the site display currency.
qy_common_irreversible_desc: Funds move immediately once confirmed. There is no way to reverse it yourself.
qy_common_acknowledge: I understand and want to continue
qy_cfg_disabled_desc: This feature is not enabled on this site.
qy_cfg_unavailable_desc: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
qy_cfg_db_down_desc: Data shown may be out of date and write actions are disabled until the service recovers.
qy_err_unavailable: Service temporarily unavailable, please try again later
qy_err_db_down: Service is degraded, write actions are temporarily disabled
qy_err_forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action
qy_err_conflict: This request was already handled by someone else. Refresh to see the latest state.
qy_err_plan_in_use: This plan is still in use, so the deletion was refused. The numbers below have been refreshed — tick force delete if you really want to void them.
qy_err_plan_delete_reason_required: A reason is required for a force delete.
qy_err_plan_seat_invalid: Invalid site-wide seat limit (0 means unlimited).
qy_err_plan_not_found: Plan not found. It may have been deleted by another admin — refresh the list.
qy_err_invalid: The request is invalid, please check your input
qy_err_rate_limited: Too many requests, please slow down
qy_err_server: Something went wrong on our side, please try again later
qy_err_network: Network error. The request may already have gone through — check the records before retrying.
qy_err_uncertain: The result could not be determined. Support will follow up — do not resubmit.
qy_err_recipient_invalid: Recipient does not exist or is disabled
qy_log_reasoning_col_tip: Normalized thinking level across providers. Hover a value to see the original parameter and token budget.
qy_log_cache_col_tip: Cached input tokens as a share of total input tokens. Older logs show a dash because their billing semantics cannot be determined.
qy_log_cache_over_tip: Upstream reported more cached tokens than total input; clamped to 100%
qy_log_metric_unknown_tip: This log predates cache metrics and lacks a billing-semantic marker, so the ratio cannot be computed accurately
qy_plan_wallet_overflow_blocked: Once the quota runs out, the model groups this plan unlocks can no longer be paid from the wallet balance and requests are rejected
qy_plan_subtitle_too_long: Plan description is limited to 255 characters
qy_plan_limits_desc: The left cap counts how many times one person may buy; the right cap counts how many people may hold the plan at once. 0 means unlimited for either.
qy_plan_seat_cap_hint: Cap on how many distinct users may hold this plan at the same time. A seat is released as soon as a subscription expires or is cancelled. 0 = unlimited.
qy_plan_seat_cap_unavailable: Seat data could not be loaded; saving now leaves the seat cap untouched.
qy_plan_seat_over_cap: (current holders already exceed this cap — existing subscriptions keep working, but nobody new can buy)
qy_plan_seat_cap_save_failed: Plan saved, but the seat cap was not stored. Reopen the plan and set it again
qy_plan_active_users_hint: Distinct users holding an active, not-yet-expired subscription; the number after the slash is the site-wide seat cap. A seat is released as soon as a subscription expires or is cancelled.
qy_plan_delete_desc: Delete the plan "{{plan}}"? This cannot be undone.
qy_plan_delete_checking: Checking what this plan still holds…
qy_plan_delete_check_failed: This plan's usage could not be loaded, so deleting is not safe right now. Try again in a moment.
qy_plan_delete_no_impact: No active subscriptions and no pending orders — safe to delete.
qy_plan_delete_cascade_warning: Force delete cancels {{subscriptions}} active subscription(s) and marks {{orders}} pending order(s) as failed. Orders already paid but not fulfilled have to be refunded by hand.
qy_plan_delete_ack: I understand this cascades and invalidates the subscriptions and orders above
qy_plan_delete_reason_ph: Required: why this plan is being force-deleted (recorded in the audit trail)
qy_plan_delete_ok: Plan deleted. Subscriptions cancelled: {{subscriptions}}, orders voided: {{orders}}.
qy_plan_duration_permanent_hint: A permanent plan has no end date, so there is no duration to fill in and the expiry job never picks it up. Note that it also never expires, which means the downgrade group below is never applied.
qy_plan_pure_product_hint: Turn this on and the plan carries no subscription balance at all — it only moves the buyer into the upgrade group, which is the thing being sold. Buyers keep paying for requests from their own wallet balance.
qy_plan_pure_product_no_quota: A pure product carries no balance, so there is no quota to set and no reset cycle to speak of. What it sells is the user group — pick one under "User group change on purchase" below, otherwise buying this plan does nothing at all.
qy_plan_group_product_title: User group change on purchase (selling the plan as a user group)
qy_plan_group_product_desc: Buying this plan moves the user into the upgrade group, and expiry moves them into the downgrade group. This is a different mechanism from the model group unlocks above: changing the user group also changes their reachable models, ratios and auto-group. Leave both empty and the plan never touches user groups.
qy_plan_upgrade_group_hint: Empty = purchasing does not touch the user group.
qy_plan_downgrade_group_hint: Empty = on expiry the user reverts to the group they held before buying (captured at purchase time). Set a value and everyone lands in that group on expiry, whatever they started from.
qy_plan_group_options_failed: The user group list could not be loaded; the dropdown only offers the value this plan already has.
qy_avl_no_series: No trend data in this range
qy_avl_cell_desc: Last {{hours}}h for this group and model
qy_avl_truncated: Too many series for one query — some cells are not shown. Narrow the group or model filter.
qy_avl_empty_no_data: No requests were recorded for the selected range.
qy_avl_kpi_overall_hint: Across the models on this page
qy_avl_definition_thresholds: Healthy at or above {{ok}}%, degraded at or above {{degraded}}%. Fewer than {{min}} samples shows no percentage at all.
qy_avl_definition_perf: Latency, TTFT and throughput count successful samples only, and show no number below {{min}} samples. Cell colours compare groups within the same model — they are not absolute targets.
qy_avl_definition_coverage: Async task models (image, video, music) produce no samples and therefore show "No data" rather than 0%.
qy_vio_rule_delete_desc: Delete "{{name}}"? Existing records keep pointing at it, so appeals can still be reviewed.
qy_vio_rule_form_desc: A rule decides who gets charged and who gets banned. Every change is written to the audit trail.
qy_vio_rules_empty_desc: Create one in shadow mode first and watch what it would have matched.
qy_vio_rule_toggle_unchanged: Nothing changed: another administrator may have already set this rule to the same state
qy_vio_rule_disable_desc: Once "{{name}}" is disabled it stops inspecting requests. Disabling raises no error and shows no warning anywhere; the only symptom is that it will never match again.
qy_vio_rule_enable_enforce_title: Enable a rule in enforce mode
qy_vio_rule_enable_enforce_desc: "{{name}}" runs in enforce mode. As long as the violation hooks are on (precheck_enabled / post_charge_enabled in the config — check the module config section table on the Extension health page), enabling it will immediately charge fees, block requests and count toward auto-ban. To observe hits first, switch it to shadow mode before enabling.
qy_vio_field_name_desc: Internal name. Never shown to users.
qy_vio_field_public_reason_desc: Shown to the user in billing logs and their violation list.
qy_vio_field_pattern_desc: Keywords and upstream text: one per line. Regex: RE2 syntax. Error and status codes: comma separated, ranges like 400-499 allowed.
qy_vio_field_model_scope_desc: Comma separated, prefix and suffix wildcards allowed. Empty means all models.
qy_vio_field_group_scope_desc: Comma separated. Empty means all groups.
qy_vio_field_group_scope_mode_desc: Applies to the group list above. An empty list always means all groups, whichever direction is selected.
qy_vio_field_count_weight_desc: How much one hit adds to the counter of the violation category selected above — and the same amount to the account-wide line. It is a multiplier against the category threshold, not a second threshold: N hits advance N x weight, and enforcement fires when that reaches the category threshold. 0 means the hit is handled by the action above only (record / charge / block still happen) and advances no line at all, so this rule can never push anyone toward a ban.
qy_vio_field_block_message_desc: Returned to the client. Never put matched terms here — that hands the rule book to abusers.
qy_vio_field_archive_context_desc: Stores the request context as evidence. Viewing it later is audited.
qy_vio_field_rate_threshold_desc: A whole number. The rule fires on the request that reaches this count of validated non-stream requests from one user within 60 seconds.
qy_vio_err_block_phase: Blocking only works before the request is forwarded — set phase to "Before upstream"
qy_vio_err_fee_action: A fee mode requires an action that charges
qy_vio_err_match_phase: This match type only works on upstream phases — it would never match before forwarding
qy_vio_err_rate_pattern: Enter a whole number between 1 and 1000000
qy_vio_err_rate_phase: Request rate only works before the request is forwarded — set phase to "Before upstream"
qy_vio_test_desc: Fill in the dimensions this rule actually reads and see at once whether it is in scope and whether it matches. Which fields appear depends on the current phase and match type.
qy_vio_test_rate_desc: Enter how many non-stream requests the user has already made this minute and see whether this rule would fire.
qy_vio_test_input_request_text_ph: Paste a request text sent by the user
qy_vio_test_input_upstream_text_ph: Paste the error body returned by the upstream
qy_vio_test_input_reject_reason_desc: In production it is appended to the upstream body and matched together, e.g. openai_finish_reason=content_filter.
qy_vio_test_input_ai_verdict_desc: Leave blank to mean the request was never sampled, or the review failed or timed out — production lets those through, so an AI rule can never match.
qy_vio_test_scope_desc: The two fields below are scope gates and may be left blank. They only decide whether this rule is in scope; they take no part in content matching.
qy_vio_test_outcome_out_of_scope: Out of scope: the rule would never run on this sample
qy_vio_test_outcome_timeout: Scan budget exhausted, no verdict this time. Production would not block either — make the rule lighter.
qy_vio_test_scope_fail_model: Blocked by the model scope: try a model inside the scope, or widen the rule model scope.
qy_vio_test_scope_fail_group: Blocked by the group scope: try a group inside the scope, or widen the rule group scope.
qy_vio_test_scope_fail_status: Blocked by the status-code scope: enter a status code inside the rule status scope.
qy_vio_test_blank_inputs: These fields are empty, so "no match" may just mean an incomplete sample: {{fields}}
qy_vio_test_criteria_now: Current criteria: phase "{{phase}}" x match type "{{match}}". These two alone decide which fields are asked below.
qy_vio_test_criteria_desc: Change them right here and the fields — and the "cannot read" notes — update immediately. It is the same rule as the two dropdowns above, not a copy.
qy_vio_test_absent_summary: This rule cannot read these dimensions: {{fields}} (expand to see why)
qy_vio_test_absent_readonly: They all exist; this rule's criteria simply do not read them — so they are notes here, not fields: filling them in would not affect the verdict.
qy_vio_test_absent_phase_no_upstream: This rule's phase is "{{phase}}", where the request has not been sent upstream yet, so nothing the upstream returns is readable.
qy_vio_test_absent_phase_not_prompt: This rule's phase is "{{phase}}", where the criteria scan what the upstream returned, not the request context sent by the user.
qy_vio_test_absent_phase_async: This rule's phase is "{{phase}}": the review runs on an async queue long after the response was delivered, so the status code takes no part in the verdict.
qy_vio_test_absent_match_not_text: This rule's match type is "{{match}}", whose criteria read no text at all.
qy_vio_test_absent_match_not_rate: This rule's match type is "{{match}}" and does not count requests in the window; only "Request rate" reads it.
qy_vio_test_absent_match_not_error_code: This rule's match type is "{{match}}" and does not compare upstream error codes; only "Error code" reads it.
qy_vio_test_absent_match_not_ai: This rule's match type is "{{match}}", so there is no external review verdict to read; only "AI review" reads these three.
qy_vio_test_ai_desc: An AI-review rule is judged on the verdict returned by an external model, not on the context itself — how the model judges cannot be reproduced locally. So enter a hypothetical verdict here: what you are verifying is whether your category allowlist and confidence floor would let it through.
qy_vio_mode_shadow_hits: {{hits}} hits in the last {{hours}}h would have been enforced if shadow mode were off.
qy_vio_evidence_audit_desc: This shows another user’s original input. The system writes an audit entry with your account, the target user and the record number.
qy_vio_evidence_no_payload: No context was archived for this record.
qy_vio_revoke_desc: Revoking rolls back the counter as well, so the user no longer carries this hit toward a ban.
qy_vio_revoke_reason_placeholder: Why is this a false positive?
qy_vio_revoke_refund_desc: Goes through the two-phase ledger, idempotent on the record number.
qy_vio_revoke_refund_na: Nothing was charged for this record.
qy_vio_unban_desc: The account is re-enabled and its tokens and sessions are refreshed.
qy_vio_unban_reset_desc: Without this the user is one hit away from being banned again. With a finite window that state clears itself once the window rolls over; with "no time limit" it never does - in that mode, not resetting means every later hit re-bans them.
qy_vio_my_empty: No violations — your account looks good
qy_vio_my_empty_desc: Nothing on your account has triggered a policy charge.
qy_vio_my_appeal_reason: Why do you think this is wrong?
qy_vio_my_appeal_placeholder: Describe what you were doing, at least {{min}} characters
qy_cfg_fund_empty_desc: No orders match this filter. Undetermined orders show up here for manual review.
qy_cfg_fund_resolve_warn_desc: Only use this after the re-probe still cannot tell whether the main database applied the change. The decision and your reason are written to the audit trail.
qy_cfg_fund_reason_placeholder: What evidence did you use? (required, stored in the audit trail)
qy_cfg_audit_action_prefix_hint: Action matches by prefix: type withdraw. to see everything under withdrawals.
qy_cfg_health_reload_desc: Re-reads the YAML file. The database section is never reloaded because connections cannot be hot-swapped.
qy_cfg_health_version_desc: Check this first when troubleshooting: which build this process is actually running.
qy_cfg_health_drop_desc: {{n}} events were dropped. Commission, violation records and availability samples in that window are gone and cannot be recovered. Increase the hot hook queue size or fix extension database latency.
qy_cfg_health_breaker_desc: Extension writes are suspended until {{time}}. Read pages may show stale data.
qy_cfg_health_dropped_hint: Non-zero means money-affecting data was lost
qy_cfg_health_leases_desc: Confirms that no two nodes run the same task at once.
qy_cfg_health_leases_empty: No leases have been taken yet
qy_cfg_health_modules_desc: Module switches are plain booleans that default to off. "No such section in the config" and "an explicit enabled: false" are the same byte inside the process — this table is the only thing that tells them apart. Sections that also have secondary switches (such as the violation pre-relay and post-billing scans) each get their own row: turning on only the main switch leaves those hooks doing nothing.
qy_cfg_health_modules_empty: No module information (the backend may be an older build)
qy_cfg_health_modules_alert_desc: {{list}} are compiled into this deployment, but nothing in the config file makes a decision about them, so they are off. Write these switches out explicitly in the config file — true to turn them on, false if you really mean to keep them off. Either way this notice goes away.
qy_cfg_health_module_effect: What happens when it is missing
qy_cfg_health_module_fix_section: Append this section to the end of the config file:
qy_cfg_health_module_fix_key: That section is already in the config file: add the line below inside the existing {{section}}: section. Do not add a second top-level {{section}}: key — a duplicate top-level key makes the config fail to parse and the gateway will not start.
qy_cfg_pii_desc: Every time an administrator decrypts payout details or opens a payment proof, a row lands here with the reason they typed. This table is kept longer than the fund audit.
qy_cfg_req_audit_desc: Every write request under /api/qy is recorded here automatically, including the ones rejected by authentication. Bodies and query strings are redacted by key name before they are stored.

qy_err_idem_required: The request is missing its idempotency key, please reload the page

qy_err_receiver_disabled: That account cannot receive transfers right now

qy_err_daily_count: You have reached today's transfer count limit

qy_err_contact_not_found: That contact is no longer in your list
qy_err_contact_user_not_found: No such account. Check the recipient you entered
qy_err_contact_self: You cannot add yourself as a contact
qy_err_contact_duplicate: That account is already in your contacts
qy_err_contact_limit: You have reached the maximum number of contacts

qy_err_wd_user_unavailable: Your account cannot request a payout right now
qy_err_wd_debt_blocked: Payouts are on hold because of a clawback balance
qy_err_wd_quota_overflow: Your account balance is already at its maximum, spend some first
qy_err_wd_daily_count: You have reached today's payout request limit
qy_err_wd_fiat_below_min: Below the minimum fiat payout amount
qy_err_wd_fee_eats_all: The net amount would be zero after fees
qy_err_wd_status_conflict: This request was already handled, refresh and try again
qy_err_wd_illegal_transition: That action is not allowed in the current state
qy_err_wd_rate_unavailable: Pricing parameters are misconfigured, please contact an administrator
qy_err_wd_pii_unavailable: Fiat payouts are temporarily unavailable, please contact an administrator
qy_err_wd_payee_undecryptable: The payout details could not be decrypted, ask the user to re-enter them
qy_err_wd_proof_disabled: This site does not accept proof images
qy_err_wd_proof_required: Please pick an image to upload
qy_err_wd_proof_too_large: That image is over the size limit
qy_err_wd_proof_type: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP images are accepted
qy_err_wd_proof_not_found: That proof image is gone or was already used, please upload it again
qy_err_wd_proof_pending_limit: You have several uploaded images that were never submitted, finish one of those requests first
qy_err_wd_proof_purged: The proof image has been deleted under the retention policy
qy_err_wd_proof_store_failed: The image could not be saved, please try again
qy_err_cm_clawback_failed: Clawback failed, check the accrual and amount
qy_tr_form_desc: The amount leaves your balance immediately and cannot be reversed by you.
qy_tr_recipient_ph_id_email: Recipient user ID or full email address
qy_tr_recipient_help_id: Exact user ID only — username search is not available.
qy_tr_recipient_help_id_email: Exact user ID or full email address — username search is not available.
qy_tr_remark_ph: Optional, visible to you and the recipient
qy_tr_confirm_desc: Check the recipient and amount once more. Funds arrive instantly and there is no self-service reversal.
qy_tr_blk_not_found: No such recipient — double-check the user ID or email.
qy_tr_blk_disabled: That account cannot receive transfers right now.
qy_tr_blk_pending_exists: You already have a transfer in progress. Wait for it to finish first.
qy_tr_blk_account_too_new: Your account is too new to start a transfer.
qy_tr_blk_unavailable: That account cannot receive transfers right now.
qy_tr_err_amount_range: Amount is outside the allowed range
qy_tr_ct_desc: Saved recipients, so you do not have to type the ID again
qy_tr_ct_search_ph: Filter by note name, username or ID
qy_tr_ct_note: Picking a contact only fills in the recipient field. You still have to verify the recipient and pass every check, including the payment password.
qy_tr_ct_delete_desc: This only removes your shortcut. Past transfers and records are not affected.
qy_tr_limits_desc: All values are computed server-side in real time.
qy_tr_empty_desc: Transfers you send or receive will show up here.
qy_tr_a_empty_desc: Try a different filter or clear the search box.
qy_tr_blk_group_denied: This account's user group is outside the range you can send to. Pick a different recipient.
qy_tr_blk_group_blocked: Your user group cannot send transfers right now. Contact an administrator if you need this.
qy_trg_delete_desc: Once deleted, group {{group}} is no longer bound by this rule and may immediately become unrestricted.
qy_trg_form_desc: A rule only constrains the sender: "A can only send to B" does not stop B from sending to A.
qy_trg_field_from_ph: Group name, or {{wildcard}} for the fallback rule
qy_trg_field_from_desc: Each group can have only one rule. Use {{wildcard}} for the fallback that covers every group without its own rule.
qy_trg_field_to_desc: Separate with commas or line breaks. Any name is accepted, it need not already exist.
qy_trg_field_enabled_desc: Disabling behaves like deleting: the group falls back to the fallback rule, or becomes unrestricted if there is none.
qy_trg_self_token_desc: means "the sender's own group". With a allow list it reads "same group only"; with a deny list it reads "no transfers within the group".
qy_trg_remark_ph: Optional. Record why this rule exists.
qy_trg_policy_allow_all_desc: This group can send to any group, including groups added later.
qy_trg_policy_allow_list_desc: This group can only send to the groups listed below; everything else is rejected.
qy_trg_policy_deny_list_desc: This group cannot send to the groups listed below; everything else is allowed.
qy_trg_policy_deny_all_desc: This group cannot start any transfer.
qy_trg_matrix_desc: Computed cell by cell on the server with the real decision function, so it always matches what users actually hit.
qy_trg_matrix_note: Covers the groups defined on this site plus every group referenced by a rule. Any other group follows the fallback rule, or is unrestricted when there is none.
qy_trg_empty_desc: An empty rule table means every group can transfer to every other group. Add a rule to start restricting.
qy_trg_at_limit: The rule limit of {{max}} has been reached. Delete a rule you no longer need first.
qy_trg_group_source_note: User groups are defined under System Settings → Billing & Payment → User groups and model groups under Model groups. This page only configures who may transfer to whom.
qy_trg_unknown_warning: These groups are not defined on this site: {{groups}}. The rule is still saved, but it never matches unless some user actually belongs to that group. Check for typos, or ignore this if it is a legacy group.
qy_trg_group_picker_empty: No matching group. Type a name to use it anyway.
qy_trg_to_picker_ph: Pick a group to append to the list
qy_trg_err_group_too_long: A group name may not exceed 64 characters.
qy_trg_err_list_too_long: The target group list may not exceed 1024 characters.
qy_trg_err_remark_too_long: The note may not exceed 255 characters.
qy_aff_link_desc: Anyone who signs up through this link is linked to you automatically.
qy_aff_frozen_hint: Reserved by a payout request; released once it is resolved.
qy_aff_debt_desc: Your commission account has a clawback balance. Future commission pays it down before payouts resume.
qy_aff_policy_desc: Configured by administrators. Changes only affect commission earned afterwards.
qy_aff_exclude_redemption: Redemption codes and manual top-ups do not earn commission.
qy_aff_exclude_subscription: Usage covered by a subscription plan does not earn commission.
qy_aff_empty_people_desc: Share the referral link from the overview page — new sign-ups appear here.
qy_aff_empty_records_desc: Entries appear once an invited user tops up or spends.
qy_wd_form_desc: Commission is put on hold as soon as you submit; you can cancel until it is reviewed.
qy_wd_m_quota_desc: Commission becomes account quota 1:1 once approved.
qy_wd_m_fiat_desc: Paid out manually to your payout account at the frozen exchange rate.
qy_wd_daily_limit_desc: At most {{max}} requests per day. Please try again tomorrow.
qy_wd_err_field_invalid: Contains characters that are not allowed
qy_wd_payee_save_hint: Saved details are encrypted at rest and never shown back to you.
qy_wd_payee_limit_reached: You can save at most {{max}} payout methods.
qy_wd_rate_title: How the fiat amount is calculated
qy_wd_rate_frozen_note: The final amount uses the rate frozen at submission time. The exact figure appears in your payout history right after you submit.
qy_wd_proof_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {{mb}} MB. Reviewers can see it; it is deleted once the request is closed.
qy_wd_proof_err_too_large: That image is larger than {{mb}} MB, please pick a smaller one
qy_wd_proof_alt: Proof image attached to this payout request
qy_wd_confirm_desc: The commission is put on hold immediately. You can cancel any time before it is approved.
qy_wd_fiat_amount_pending: Fixed at submission using the frozen rate
qy_wd_auto_credit_hint: Balance conversions are credited automatically once approved.
qy_wd_empty_desc: Once you submit a request you can follow its review and payout here.
qy_wd_tl_review_waiting: Waiting for an administrator to review it.
qy_wd_tl_rejected_desc: Reason: {{reason}}. The held commission has been returned.
qy_wd_tl_rejected_no_reason: Rejected. The held commission has been returned.
qy_wd_tl_payout_skipped: The request was rejected, so no payout will be made.
qy_wd_tl_failed_desc: Reason: {{reason}}. The held commission has been returned.
qy_wd_tl_failed_no_reason: Payout failed. The held commission has been returned.
qy_wd_tl_cancelled_desc: You cancelled this request; the held commission has been returned.
qy_wd_a_hold_title: Reconciliation mismatch — needs a human decision
qy_wd_a_hold_desc: Whether the main database was credited cannot be determined automatically. Check the user's balance history and logs before deciding; do not guess.
qy_wd_risk_shared_payee: These payout details were used by another account before. Confirm it is the same real-world payee.
qy_wd_a_payout_ref_ph: Bank reference or transfer receipt number
qy_wd_a_payout_ref_hint: Required. A payout record without a reference is worthless during reconciliation.
qy_wd_a_reason_ph: Be specific — the user sees this verbatim
qy_wd_a_reason_visible: This text is shown to the user. Do not include internal information.
qy_wd_a_evidence_ph: State what you checked to decide whether the money moved
qy_wd_a_empty_title: No matching requests in the queue
qy_wd_a_stat_hold_hint: Someone has to decide whether the money arrived.
qy_wd_reveal_desc: This action is fully logged. Use it only to verify payout information.
qy_wd_reveal_audit_desc: Your account, the time, your IP and the reason you type are recorded in the PII access audit.
qy_wd_reveal_reason_ph: e.g. verifying the bank account before paying out
qy_wd_reveal_reason_hint: At least {{min}} characters. Explain why the plaintext is needed now.
qy_cm_editable_desc: Changes take effect immediately, apply only to commission earned afterwards, and are written to the audit log.
qy_cm_yaml_desc: These affect security and startup behaviour and can only be changed in the config file.
qy_cm_yaml_note_title: Why these are not editable here
qy_cm_yaml_note_desc: They decide which usage earns commission and how background jobs are paced. Changing them live would produce two different accounting rules within the same day.
qy_cm_confirm_desc: Rates decide how much the platform pays out. This change is recorded together with your account.
qy_cm_f_percent_hint: Enter a percentage, up to two decimals: 10 / 10.5 / 10.25.
qy_cm_gr_desc: Set a separate commission rate for a specific group. Groups without a rule use the global default (top-up {{topup}}% / usage {{consume}}%).
qy_cm_gr_scope_title: Based on the invitee's group, not the inviter's
qy_cm_gr_scope_desc: Commission is computed on the quota the invitee spends or tops up, and the platform's margin on that quota depends on the invitee's group multiplier — so the rate follows the invitee. Keying it on the inviter's group would let anyone raise the rate on all their downlines simply by buying a higher tier for themselves. The rate is frozen into the ledger row at accrual time, so later changes never rewrite historical commission.
qy_cm_gr_group_hint: The user group name from the main database. Case sensitive.
qy_cm_gr_empty: No per-group rules yet — every group uses the global default.
qy_cm_gr_delete_desc: The group falls back to the global default (top-up {{topup}}% / usage {{consume}}%) — it does not become a zero rate. Commission already paid out is unaffected. This change is written to the audit log.
qy_cm_f_min_settle_hint: Commission is only credited once it reaches this amount. Must be greater than 0.
qy_cm_f_holding_days_hint: Commission becomes withdrawable this many days after it is earned.
qy_cm_f_large_alert_hint: Alerts when a single accrual exceeds this amount. 0 disables the alert.
qy_cm_f_min_invitee_age_hint: Invitees younger than this earn no commission. 0 means no limit.
qy_tc_editable_desc: Changes take effect immediately, apply only to transfers started afterwards, and are written to the audit log together with your account.
qy_tc_invalid_state_title: Current limits contradict each other; transfers are paused
qy_tc_invalid_state_desc: The values currently stored contradict each other (for example the per-transfer minimum exceeds the maximum), so no amount can ever pass validation and the backend has paused transfers. Fix them below and save.
qy_tc_zero_note_desc: When the daily quota or daily count is 0, the user-facing "remaining today" block is not shown at all - showing "0 left" would read as "already used up". Set them above 0 if you want users to see how much is left.
qy_tc_confirm_desc: These limits decide how much one account can move out in a day. This change is written to the audit log together with your account.
qy_tc_yaml_desc: Security and structural settings; change the config file and reload.
qy_tc_yaml_note_title: Why these cannot be changed online
qy_tc_yaml_note_desc: The master switch decides whether the feature works at all; the recipient lookup mode decides whether accounts can be looked up by email, which is a user enumeration surface; the lookup log retention holds user input. Each has a wide blast radius and needs an explicit release.
qy_tc_f_min_quota_hint: Transfers below this amount are rejected up front. 0 means no minimum. Must not exceed the per-transfer maximum.
qy_tc_f_max_per_tx_hint: Anything above this is rejected. Setting it to 0 removes the per-transfer cap (the gate is off) — it does not freeze transfers. When non-zero it must be at least the per-transfer minimum, otherwise no amount is ever valid.
qy_tc_f_daily_zero_hint: Counted per calendar day, reset automatically. 0 means no limit, and then the user side shows no remaining amount.
qy_tc_f_cooldown_hint: Minimum gap between two transfers from the same account. 0 means no limit.
qy_tc_f_receiver_in_hint: How many transfers one account may receive per day. This is the only gate against many small accounts funnelling into a single one. 0 means no limit.
qy_tc_f_freeze_hours_hint: Accounts younger than this cannot send transfers. 0 means no limit.
qy_tc_f_fee_bps_hint: Integer basis points: 500 = 5%. The fee is destroyed, it does not land in any account. 0 disables the fee, and then the fee floor has no effect either.
qy_tc_f_fee_min_hint: If the computed fee is below this value, this value is charged instead. Only applies when the fee rate is above 0.
qy_tc_f_pwd_attempts_hint: Lock the payment feature after this many consecutive wrong entries. At least 1 - 0 would mean never lock.
qy_tc_f_pwd_lock_hint: How long the lock lasts once the attempt limit is hit. Admins can release it early from user management. At least 1 minute.
qy_cm_block_default_reason: Stopped manually from the commission review page
qy_cm_clawback_quota_hint: Positive integer. Anything beyond the original accrual becomes a debt and blocks the user's payouts.
qy_cm_clawback_reason_ph: Required. Explain why this commission is being taken back.
qy_cm_empty_desc: Try a different filter or clear the inviter ID.
qy_ug_desc: Choose the group new sign-ups land in. Existing users are untouched.
qy_ug_field_hint: Leave unset to keep the built-in default group {{group}} — identical to the behaviour before this setting existed.
qy_ug_no_channel_title: This group has no usable channel
qy_ug_no_channel_desc: The selected group has no enabled model in the ability table, so new users would not be able to call any model. Configure a channel for it first, or pick another group.
qy_ug_status_desc: "Configured" is the saved value; "Effective" is the group new users actually get right now.
qy_ug_stale_desc: Group {{group}} is gone from both the User Group Registry below and the group ratio table, so new users are falling back to {{fallback}}. Please pick another group.
qy_ug_probe_failed_desc: The ability table could not be read, so the channel hints in the dropdown are unavailable. The group list itself is still accurate.
qy_ug_confirm_desc: Every new sign-up from now on lands in this group. Existing users are untouched. The change is written to the audit log.
qy_pp_err_not_set: Set a payment password first — balance transfers require it.
qy_pp_err_required: Enter your payment password to continue.
qy_pp_err_locked: Payment password is locked. Wait until it expires, or reset it by email.
qy_pp_err_already_set: A payment password is already set. Use "Change" instead.
qy_pp_err_weak: Too weak: use 6-64 bytes, and avoid repeated or sequential digits.
qy_pp_err_same_as_old: The new payment password must differ from the current one.
qy_pp_err_email_unbound: No email is bound to this account. Bind one in your profile first.
qy_pp_err_code_invalid: The verification code is invalid or has expired.
qy_pp_err_mail_unavailable: Mail service is unavailable. Try again later.
qy_pp_err_too_simple: Avoid repeated characters or sequential digits.
qy_pp_err_confirm_mismatch: The two entries do not match.
qy_pp_field_help: {{remaining}} attempts left. After that the feature locks for {{minutes}} minutes.
qy_pp_status_unavailable_desc: The service is temporarily unreachable, so transfers cannot be submitted. Try again shortly.
qy_pp_setup_required_desc: Balance transfers need a payment password. Set one first — it takes a moment.
qy_pp_locked_desc: Too many wrong attempts. Unlocks at {{time}}, or reset it by email now.
qy_pp_status_policy_value: {{max}} wrong attempts then locked for {{minutes}} minutes
qy_pp_set_desc: Required before your first balance transfer. Do not reuse your login password.
qy_pp_change_desc: You must enter the current one — a wrong attempt counts toward the lockout.
qy_pp_strength_help: {{min}}-{{max}} bytes. No repeated characters, no sequential digits.
qy_pp_recover_desc: The code goes to the email bound to this account. It cannot be sent anywhere else.
qy_pp_recover_code_ph: From the email we just sent
qy_pp_recover_ok: Payment password reset. Any lock has been cleared.
qy_pp_recover_unbound_desc: Bind an email in your profile first, then come back. For security, an email cannot be bound from this page.
qy_vio_counter_desc: Hits accumulated in the rolling {{hours}}h window; {{threshold}} triggers an automatic ban. Shadow hits are no longer counted. Counts recorded before this upgrade may still include shadow hits — reset them one by one here when needed (audited).
qy_vio_counter_reset_desc: Reset the {{count}} hits in the current window for user {{user}}? Lifetime hits and the ban cycle are left untouched, and the action is audited.
qy_vio_counter_reset_reason: Clear violation counts left over from shadow mode
qy_vio_group_scope_failed: Could not load the group list, so the dropdown is empty. Type group names manually below — saving is not affected.
qy_vio_group_scope_empty: No group is defined on this site yet. Type group names manually below.
qy_vio_group_scope_unknown: These groups are not defined on this site: {{groups}}. The rule is still saved, but it never matches unless some user actually belongs to that group. Check for typos, or ignore this if it is a legacy group.
qy_vio_rate_caveat_false_positive: Legitimate users do run high non-stream rates: embedding batches, bulk classification, agent tool loops, structured-output pipelines. Exempt them by group below instead of lowering the threshold.
qy_vio_rate_caveat_ladder: For a ladder, write two rules on the same signal: a lower threshold that records (feeding the auto-ban counter) and a higher one that blocks.
qy_vio_rate_caveat_nodes: Counting uses Redis when the site has it. Without Redis each node counts on its own, so on an N-node deployment one node only sees about 1/N of the traffic and the effective threshold is N times higher.
qy_vio_rate_caveat_stream: A client can bypass it completely by sending "stream": true. Streaming requests are neither counted nor judged. This is a limit of the signal itself, not a bug to be fixed later.
qy_vio_rate_caveat_title: Read before you rely on this rule
qy_vio_rate_degraded_desc: Redis is unavailable or not configured, so each node counts on its own. On a multi-node deployment one node sees only a fraction of the traffic and every request-rate threshold is effectively that many times higher. Do not lower thresholds to compensate — they will all fire at once when Redis comes back.
qy_vio_rate_degraded_title: Request-rate counting is running per node
qy_cb_formula: withdrawable + frozen + withdrawn = settled total − clawed back
qy_cb_formula_hint: These four quota columns are not four independent numbers; they are bound by the identity above. "Has commission but cannot withdraw" almost always means the quota is still frozen (a withdrawal is under review) or already counted as withdrawn. A red check badge means this row no longer reconciles with the settlement ledger — investigate before touching it.
qy_cb_totals: Totals for this filter: withdrawable {{available}}, withdrawn {{withdrawn}}
qy_cb_empty_desc: A balance row is only created the first time a user earns commission. Try another filter, or confirm this person really has invitee activity.
qy_cb_set_target_hint: Enter the total this person has already been paid historically, not the amount to add. Maximum {{ceiling}} (current withdrawn + current withdrawable). Submitting the same number again is a no-op.
qy_cb_set_preview: Submitting moves {{delta}} quota {{direction}}; this user's withdrawable becomes {{next}}.
qy_cb_set_preview_noop: Same as the current value. Nothing will change (an audit entry is still written).
qy_cb_set_over_ceiling: Above the {{ceiling}} ceiling: withdrawable would go negative and the ledger would stop reconciling with the settlement records.
qy_cb_set_reason_ph: Required, at least 4 characters. State which system the number came from and on what basis.
qy_cb_set_reason_hint: This edits the ledger directly. The reason is stored in the audit log together with a full before/after snapshot.
qy_cb_set_noop: Withdrawn quota already equals that value; nothing changed
qy_err_cb_over_available: Withdrawn quota cannot exceed current withdrawn + current withdrawable, or withdrawable would go negative
qy_err_cb_over_earned: Withdrawn quota exceeds this user's net settled total: the balance row itself has drifted, reconcile it first
qy_err_cb_overflow: Rollback too large: the restored withdrawable quota would exceed the per-account cap
qy_rel_authority: The authoritative field is users.inviter_id in the main database
qy_rel_authority_hint: The "Bound" tab reads the main database directly: commission accrual only ever consults users.inviter_id. The relation snapshot in the extension database is created lazily (only once a downline first earns commission), so it holds fewer rows than there are real bindings and cannot be used as the source. The "Unbound" tab can only read that snapshot — after unbinding, inviter_id in the main database is cleared and nothing there remembers who the inviter was.
qy_rel_empty_desc: Try another filter, or switch to "Unbound" for historical relations. Bound relations come from users.inviter_id in the main database.
qy_rel_bind_desc: Attach an account that currently has no inviter to the inviter you specify.
qy_rel_bind_warning: This is not a display setting: once submitted, every future top-up and every request the invitee pays for will earn commission for this inviter at the current rate. It does NOT grant the upstream invite bonus (aff_quota) retroactively — that quota is issued at signup, and awarding it later would create money out of nothing. An account that already has an inviter must be unbound first; this endpoint never repoints an existing relation.
qy_rel_invitee_id_hint: Must be an account that currently has no inviter.
qy_rel_inviter_id_hint: The invite chain is walked upwards to detect cycles: A invites B and B invites A (and longer rings) are rejected.
qy_rel_reason_hint: Required, at least 4 characters. The reason is stored in the audit log together with full before/after snapshots.
qy_rel_bind_reason_ph: State the evidence, e.g. the ticket number or the referral link the user supplied.
qy_rel_unbind_semantics: Unbinding only stops future accrual. Every commission already earned is kept — including amounts already settled into the withdrawable balance and amounts already paid out. The accrual ledger is append-only; deleting rows would break the match between total accrued and total settled. To claw back commission that was already paid, use "Clawback" separately and state a reason.
qy_rel_unbind_reason_ph: State why this relation is being dissolved, e.g. the ticket number and the finding.
qy_err_rel_self_invite: The inviter and the invitee cannot be the same account
qy_err_rel_user_not_found: The inviter or the invitee does not exist (or has been deleted)
qy_err_rel_already_bound: This account already has an inviter. Repointing it would move future commission from one person to another, so it must be unbound explicitly first
qy_err_rel_cycle: This binding would create an invite cycle (A invites B, B invites A, or a longer ring) and was rejected
qy_err_rel_not_bound: This account currently has no inviter, so there is nothing to unbind
qy_err_rel_conflict: The relation was just changed by another operation. Refresh the list and try again
qy_adj_ledger_note: This posts a "manual adjustment" accrual row (with a serial number, a reason and an operator) which the normal settlement run then absorbs into the withdrawable balance — it does not edit the balance figure directly. That is why it shows up in the commission ledger and why total accrued always reconciles with total settled.
qy_adj_amount_hint_add: Positive integer. The added amount matures immediately and settles into the withdrawable balance on this submit.
qy_adj_amount_hint_sub: Positive integer, guideline cap {{ceiling}}. The real cap is withdrawable + unsettled remainder + matured pending commission, recomputed server-side inside the locked transaction; the number here comes from the list snapshot and may be stale.
qy_adj_over_ceiling: Above the reclaimable cap of {{ceiling}}: anything more would record a debt against this user, and a debt freezes their withdrawals.
qy_adj_reason_ph: Required, at least 4 characters. State why the amount is added or deducted, e.g. ticket number or campaign compensation.
qy_adj_reason_hint: The reason is stored on the accrual row and in the audit log, alongside before/after balance snapshots.
qy_adj_replayed: Same request as the previous submit — the ledger did not change again
qy_err_adj_over_reclaimable: The deduction exceeds the reclaimable cap (withdrawable + unsettled remainder + matured pending commission). Going further would record a debt against this user and freeze their withdrawals
qy_err_adj_overflow: Increase too large: the resulting withdrawable commission would exceed the per-account quota cap
qy_err_adj_user_not_found: That user does not exist (or has been deleted). Check the user ID
qy_err_adj_idem_conflict: This dialog's request id was already used: the amount from the previous submit is already posted. Close and reopen the dialog before changing the amount, otherwise the payout would be duplicated
qy_vio_field_mode_shadow_desc: Match and record only - no charge, no block, no ban, and no violation counting. Hits are archived together with their context so you can pull the logs of suspected abusers and analyse them. Switch to enforcing once you trust the false-positive rate.
qy_vio_field_mode_enforce_desc: This rule really performs the action configured above: charging, blocking, and counting violations towards an automatic ban. Watch its hits in shadow mode for a while before switching.
qy_vio_mode_all_shadow_title: Every rule is in shadow mode
qy_vio_mode_all_shadow_desc: All {{shadow}} enabled rules only record - nothing is charged, blocked, banned or counted.
qy_vio_mode_mixed_desc: {{enforce}} enforcing, {{shadow}} in shadow. {{blocked}} requests were blocked in the last {{hours}}h.
qy_vio_breaker_title: Circuit breaker tripped - every rule is temporarily running as shadow
qy_vio_breaker_desc: The block rate or ban rate spiked, so every rule was automatically clamped to shadow (no charge, no block, no ban) to stop one over-broad rule from hitting the whole site. This is not a mode switch - each rule keeps its own mode and returns to it once the breaker clears. Review whatever you changed most recently.
qy_vio_breaker_until: Clears automatically at {{time}}; you can also clear it manually once the rule is fixed.
qy_vio_builtin_desc: Covers jailbreak, prompt extraction, distillation (bulk harvesting) and prompt injection. Select nothing to import everything; imported rules are ordinary rows you can edit, delete and toggle individually.
qy_vio_builtin_shadow_title: Everything is imported in shadow mode
qy_vio_builtin_shadow_desc: Regex matching has an unpredictable false-positive rate, so built-in rules only record. Watch their hits for a while, then decide rule by rule whether to enforce.
qy_vio_builtin_upgrade_label: Also upgrade rules imported from older versions (rules whose pattern you edited are skipped, never overwritten)
qy_vio_builtin_modified_hint: You edited this rule's pattern, so upgrading will not overwrite it. Merge the new pattern by hand if you want it.
qy_vio_builtin_disabled_hint: This rule is disabled on this site. Re-importing or upgrading will not turn it back on — enable it manually in the rule list.
qy_vio_shadow_hits_desc: What this rule caught while running in shadow mode. Recorded but not punished - use it to judge the false-positive rate and what would happen if you switched it to enforcing.
qy_maint_version_uninjected_hint: No version was injected at build time (plain `go build`); build via qianye/scripts/build instead
qy_lot_kind_draw_hint: The platform collects entry fees and pays the prizes. The two sides are not meant to balance — payouts mint new quota.
qy_lot_kind_guess_hint: Pool-based: the total stake minus the fee is split among winners in proportion. If nobody wins, every stake is refunded in full and no fee is taken.
qy_lot_intro_plain_hint: Rendered as plain text. HTML and Markdown are not parsed.
qy_lot_stake_hint: Deducted from the main balance. Entries cannot be withdrawn. Must be greater than 0.
qy_lot_draw_at_hint: Must be at least one mandatory delay after closing. The roster hash is published first and the seed only afterwards; that gap is when anyone can snapshot the evidence.
qy_lot_settle_deadline_hint: If no result is entered by then the activity is voided and everything refunded. Without it a pool can be held indefinitely.
qy_lot_allow_multi_win_hint: Frozen on publish: it goes into the commitment hash and decides how the draw deduplicates.
qy_lot_fee_bps_hint: About {{percent}}% right now. Charged only when there are both winners and losers.
qy_lot_fee_desc: Platform fee is about {{percent}}%, taken from the pool before it is split proportionally.
qy_lot_no_winner_note: If nobody guesses right — or everybody does — every stake is refunded in full and no fee is taken.
qy_lot_min_entries_hint: Voided and fully refunded below {{count}} entries
qy_lot_min_entries_hint_field: Below this the activity is voided and fully refunded, at no loss to the platform. It is the only stop-loss, and it is fair to everyone.
qy_lot_min_entries_guess_hint: Below this the activity is voided and fully refunded, so two people never end up betting against each other.
qy_lot_dedup_ip_note: IP deduplication is on for this activity. People sharing an exit IP at home, work, school or behind carrier NAT may be blocked with no way to prove otherwise.
qy_lot_empty_draw_desc: Draws pay out by prize tier and the entry fee is not refunded. Lotto lives here too: pick your own numbers and the tier follows how many red and blue balls you match. New rounds appear here.
qy_lot_empty_guess_desc: Guessing games share a pool: the total stake minus the fee is split among the winners in proportion to their stakes. New rounds appear here.
qy_lot_entry_hidden_note: The site is not showing the entertainment entry right now; you reached this page by direct link. Ongoing activities are unaffected.
qy_lot_no_catch_all_desc: Without a "none of the above" option, everybody guessing wrong becomes common — and that means a full refund and zero revenue.
qy_lot_break_even_note: Below {{count}} entries this activity runs at a loss; the gap is newly minted quota paid by the platform.
qy_lot_large_prize_desc: The prize total is above the alert threshold. Double-check for an extra zero: payouts cannot be clawed back.
qy_lot_rules_frozen_desc: These conditions were frozen at publish time and folded into the commitment hash. They cannot change while the activity runs.
qy_lot_rule_recent_spend: Spent at least {{amount}} in the last {{days}} day(s)
qy_lot_rule_admin_excluded: Administrators and the activity's creator can never enter (not configurable)
qy_lot_rule_f_group_allow_hint: Comma-separated. Leave empty for no restriction.
qy_lot_rule_f_group_deny_hint: Exclusion wins when both lists are set.
qy_lot_rule_f_account_age_hint: 0 means no limit. Keeps freshly registered throwaway accounts out.
qy_lot_rule_f_min_quota_hint: 0 means no limit. It checks the balance at the moment of entry, not sustained holdings — the same money moved between accounts satisfies it for each of them.
qy_lot_rule_f_used_quota_hint: 0 means no limit. All-time figure; the window cannot be narrowed.
qy_lot_rule_f_spend_days_hint: Only takes effect together with the amount below. The daily rollup lags by minutes and can only under-count, never over-count.
qy_lot_rule_f_violation_hint: Shadow-mode hits and revoked records do not count.
qy_lot_rule_f_violation_hits_hint: 0 means no limit. It sits alongside the switch above rather than replacing it: you may only want to keep out people who have been noisy lately, not veto anyone with a single old record.
qy_lot_rule_f_ever_banned_hint: Only reads the violation system's auto-ban table. Manual bans by an admin are not recorded there — use the next switch as well.
qy_lot_rule_f_disabled_hint: Reads the account status. Manual admin bans show up only here.
qy_lot_rule_no_kyc_note: This system holds no identity verification data. The three switches below are the available proxies: they do not prove identity, they only raise the cost of running throwaway accounts.
qy_lot_rule_f_max_attempts_hint: Counts failed attempts too. A failed entry permanently occupies a sequence number; without this cap the public roster can be inflated with requests that are certain to fail.
qy_lot_rule_f_max_total_entries_hint: 0 falls back to the system hard limit. When multiple entries are allowed, a per-person cap does not stop one person placing many.
qy_lot_rule_f_cooldown_hint: 0 means no limit. A per-person cap will not stop a script firing repeatedly in the last second before close.
qy_lot_rule_f_per_inviter_hint: 0 means no limit. It only constrains accounts that actually have an inviter — accounts registered without an invite link are not covered.
qy_lot_rule_f_dedup_ip_hint: Off by default. It blocks real users who share an exit IP at home, at work, at school or behind carrier NAT, and they have no way to prove otherwise; once an exit IP is taken for an activity it cannot be released. Make sure the trade-off is worth it.
qy_lot_elig_ok_desc: This is a pre-check against current data. The decision at submit time is what counts.
qy_lot_miss_creator: The creator cannot enter their own activity
qy_lot_miss_disabled: Your account is not in good standing
qy_lot_miss_group: Your user group is not eligible
qy_lot_miss_account_age: Account too new (needs {{need}} days, you have {{have}})
qy_lot_miss_balance: Balance below the threshold (needs {{need}}, you have {{have}})
qy_lot_miss_stake: Not enough balance to cover the entry fee (needs {{need}}, you have {{have}})
qy_lot_miss_used_quota: Lifetime spend too low (needs {{need}}, you have {{have}})
qy_lot_miss_recent_spend: Recent spend too low (needs {{need}}, you have {{have}})
qy_lot_miss_violation_hits: Too many recent violations (cap {{need}}, you have {{have}})
qy_lot_join_warn_title: The fee is charged immediately and cannot be undone
qy_lot_join_warn_desc: The fee comes out of your main balance. There is no cancel and no undo — refunds only happen if the whole activity is cancelled or voided.
qy_lot_receipt_keep_desc: The chain hash was issued by the platform at the moment you entered. If the roster is altered later, your copy will no longer match. You can always find it again under My entries.
qy_lot_records_empty_desc: Once you enter a draw or a guessing game, your receipts and results stay here.
qy_lot_records_chain_note: The chain hash is your proof of entry — click to copy. It should match the public evidence chain on the activity page character for character.
qy_lot_fairness_desc: Only the hash of the seed is published up front; the seed itself is revealed after the draw. Anyone can recompute the result, and nobody can change it afterwards.
qy_lot_fairness_not_ready: The evidence chain is published once entries close. The roster hash goes out before the seed does, and that gap is exactly when anyone can save a snapshot.
qy_lot_vf_local_note: Verification runs entirely in your browser and never calls a server-side verify endpoint. The download is a self-contained evidence file; a dependency-free offline script in the repository verifies it as-is.
qy_lot_vf_partial_desc: Only {{loaded}} of {{total}} records were loaded, so the chain and roster cannot be verified. Download the full data and use the offline script.
qy_lot_vf_step_chain: Hash chain intact — no entry inserted or removed
qy_lot_vf_step_roster: Roster was frozen before the seed was revealed
qy_lot_tl_commit_desc: At publish time the rules, prizes, the four timestamps and the seed hash are frozen.
qy_lot_tl_freeze_desc: The roster hash is published when entries close — while the seed is still sealed.
qy_lot_tl_reveal_desc: The seed is published at draw time, so anyone can recompute the winners.
qy_lot_roster_desc: Published after entries close. It shows entrant refs rather than usernames; all tickets from the same person share one ref.
qy_lot_roster_sealed: The roster is published after entries close. Publishing it live would change how people bet.
qy_lot_roster_status_note: The hash chain deliberately excludes settlement status — otherwise every failed charge would break it. Whether a given entry went through is cross-checked against the fund order and your own quota ledger.
qy_lot_a_empty_desc: All three play styles start from "Create activity" in the top right: draw (the platform funds the prizes), guessing game (the pool is redistributed) and lotto (players pick numbers, the pool rolls over between issues). Lotto additionally needs an open issue series.
qy_lot_a_stat_fee_hint: Guessing games only, and it creates no fund order: the money was already taken at bet time, so the fee is simply what is not paid out.
qy_lot_a_stat_held_hint: Money that is owed but could not be paid automatically. It is still an obligation, so it is subtracted from the net figure.
qy_lot_a_net_hint: Fees plus platform fee, minus payouts, refunds and money on hold. A negative figure is normal for draws — the prizes are newly minted by the platform.
qy_lot_create_draft_note: This creates a draft — everything is still editable. The irreversible step is Publish, on the detail page.
qy_lot_create_confirm_desc: Please double-check the entry fee and the prize total.
qy_lot_step_basic_desc: Type, title, entry fee and the four timestamps. All read-only once published.
qy_lot_step_spec_desc: Prize tiers or guessing options. They go into the commitment hash — adding one later proves itself inconsistent.
qy_lot_step_rules_desc: Who can enter, how often, and how duplicates are handled. The cost of each switch is spelled out next to it.
qy_lot_step_review_desc: Your last look at the fields about to be frozen forever, and at the worst-case net issuance.
qy_lot_v_stake_required: Entry fee must be greater than 0 (free entries are not supported in v1)
qy_lot_v_time_order: Timestamps are out of order: open < close ≤ draw
qy_lot_v_deadline_order: The settle deadline cannot precede the draw
qy_lot_v_reveal_delay: The gap between closing and the draw is shorter than the mandatory reveal delay
qy_lot_v_tier_required: At least one prize is required
qy_lot_v_tier_amount: Prize amount and count must both be greater than 0
qy_lot_v_prize_over_cap: The prize total exceeds the per-activity cap — check for an extra zero
qy_lot_v_option_min: A guessing game needs at least two options
qy_lot_v_catch_all_dup: Only one catch-all option is allowed
qy_lot_v_spend_not_ready: The daily spend rollup has not been backfilled yet — a recent-spend condition would reject everyone
qy_lot_v_spend_window_too_long: The recent-spend window is longer than the available history
qy_lot_v_attempts_lt_entries: The attempt cap cannot be lower than the entry cap
qy_lot_v_total_entries_hard: The total entries cap exceeds the system hard limit
qy_lot_win_ppm_sum_hint: The remaining {{percent}}% is the no-win band - a first-class outcome, not a gap. The total must not exceed 100%.
qy_lot_allow_multi_win_forced: Always on in probability mode: every ticket rolls independently, and de-duplicating by user turns a ticket's real odds into 1-(1-p)^k, so the published probability would no longer be true. Use the per-user entry cap to throttle instead.
qy_lot_v_win_ppm_range: In probability mode every tier's win probability must fall in (0, 1000000] ppm
qy_lot_v_win_ppm_sum: Win probabilities across tiers must not exceed 100%
qy_lot_v_prob_budget_short: In probability mode each tier's budget (count x amount) must be at least the activity-wide entry cap, otherwise an over-subscribed tier can dilute a winner down to 0
qy_lot_publish_desc: Publishing folds the rules, prizes, timestamps and seed into a commitment hash and freezes them permanently. After that you can only cancel the whole activity — you cannot pick a result.
qy_lot_cancelled: Cancelled. Refunds will be issued one by one.
qy_lot_cancel_warn_title: Cancelling refunds everyone and is shown publicly
qy_lot_cancel_warn_desc: Every entry fee is returned in full and the platform earns nothing. The reason is written to the event log and visible to entrants. Cancelling after entries close carries an extra cost: the roster is frozen and the seed already exists, so anyone can later use the published seed to recompute who would have won and weigh that against your decision.
qy_lot_cancel_reason_hint: Required and shown publicly. A cancellation without a stated reason is indistinguishable, after the fact, from calling it off because the result was inconvenient.
qy_lot_result_evidence_hint: Required and public. A link, a quote or a screenshot hash — it is the only thing anyone can use to check this result.
qy_lot_result_warn_title: The result cannot be changed once written
qy_lot_result_warn_desc: A guessing result is an off-chain fact and no algorithm can prove it for you. If you get it wrong the only remedy is voiding the activity, refunding everyone, and saying so publicly.
qy_lot_result_ack: I have checked the evidence and confirm this is the final result
qy_lot_retry_desc: This only re-queues the existing payout. It never creates a second one and never pays twice. If the fund order has not settled, the retry is refused until someone checks the ledger.
qy_lot_cfg_editable_desc: Changes take effect immediately and apply to every activity created afterwards. Each save is audited.
qy_lot_cfg_confirm_desc: Here is exactly what will change.
qy_lot_cfg_invalid_desc: Some stored overrides are out of range; they were discarded and fell back to the config file, which means a setting you believe you changed is not actually in effect. Save this page again to fix it.
qy_lot_cfg_show_entry_title: Hiding the entry is not the same as switching it off
qy_lot_cfg_show_entry_note: Turning off the frontend entry only hides the user-facing links. Ongoing activities still close, draw and pay out, and entrants can still reach their results by link. To stop the feature entirely, change the master switch in the config file.
qy_lot_cfg_h_show_entry: When off, Lottery and My entries disappear from the user navigation. The admin side is unaffected.
qy_lot_cfg_h_max_active_activities: Stops more activities being opened than operations can actually watch.
qy_lot_cfg_h_default_guess_fee_bps: The starting value for new guessing games; still adjustable per activity.
qy_lot_cfg_h_max_guess_fee_bps: Guards against typing 50% when you meant 5%.
qy_lot_cfg_h_max_total_prize_quota: The only gate that catches an extra zero. Draw payouts mint new quota and cannot be clawed back. It can only be lowered within the range set in the config file.
qy_lot_cfg_h_large_prize_alert_quota: Above this you get a warning but not a block: big activities are legitimate, they just deserve a second look.
qy_lot_cfg_yaml_desc: Safety and structural parameters. They can only be changed in the file and reloaded.
qy_lot_cfg_spend_not_ready_note: The daily spend rollup has not finished backfilling. Until it does, a recent-spend condition would reject everyone, and creating such an activity is refused outright.
qy_lot_err_not_open: This activity is not accepting entries
qy_lot_err_closing_soon: Entries are closed as the activity is about to end
qy_lot_err_user_cap: You have reached the entry limit for this activity
qy_lot_err_attempt_cap: You have reached the submission limit (failed attempts included)
qy_lot_err_inviter_cap: The per-inviter participant limit has been reached
qy_lot_err_ip_cap: This activity allows one participant per network address
qy_lot_err_entry_in_flight: Your previous entry is still being processed
qy_lot_err_ineligible: You do not meet the entry requirements yet
qy_lot_err_bad_option: That option does not belong to this activity. Refresh and try again.
qy_lot_err_bad_amount: Stake amount is outside the allowed range
qy_lot_err_bad_request_id: Invalid request id. Refresh the page and try again.
qy_lot_err_idem_conflict: This submission does not match the previous one. Refresh the page and enter again.
qy_lot_err_not_settled: This operation has not settled yet. Do not resubmit — check My entries again shortly.
qy_lot_err_entry_excluded: This entry was charged after the roster closed; the fee will be refunded automatically. Track it under My entries.
qy_lot_err_user_unavailable: Your account status does not allow this action
qy_lot_err_quota_overflow: Crediting would exceed the balance cap; please spend some quota first
qy_lot_err_status_conflict: The activity state changed. Refresh and try again.
qy_lot_err_result_locked: The result is final; a mistake can only be voided with a full refund
qy_lot_err_prize_cap: Total prize amount exceeds the system cap
qy_lot_err_active_cap: Too many activities are currently running
qy_lot_err_spend_not_ready: Spend statistics have not been backfilled to that window yet
qy_lot_err_payout_needs_manual: This payout has not settled or conflicts with the ledger probe; it cannot be retried automatically until someone checks the records
qy_lot_err_proof_not_ready: The evidence chain is published only after entries close
qy_lot_err_proof_disabled: Public access to the evidence chain is disabled on this site
qy_lot_risk_badge_may_lose_principal: Predictions redistribute a pool - a wrong guess loses your stake
qy_lot_no_winner_possible: A roll outside every range means no win - this draw may have no winners at all.
qy_lot_roll_bias_notice: The roll scales the ticket's first 64 bits into 0-999999; bucket sizes differ by at most 1 (relative bias below 2⁻⁴⁴).
qy_lot_why_loading: Fetching the proof and recomputing in your browser…
qy_lot_why_rank_deduped: A higher-ranked ticket from your account took the slot; this one was skipped
qy_lot_why_not_won: {{roll}} falls outside every range - that is the whole reason you did not win.
qy_lot_why_verify_hint: Every number above was recomputed in your browser from the public proof - no server-side verification endpoint was called. You can also download the proof and recompute the same row offline.
qy_lot_why_blocked_incomplete: The proof is incomplete. A single missing row breaks the chain, and "broken" is indistinguishable from "tampered with" - so no conclusion is shown.
qy_lot_why_blocked_not_revealed: The seed has not been revealed yet - nobody, including the platform, can compute the result.
qy_lot_why_blocked_not_in_roster: This entry is not in the frozen roster (it failed, or was still pending at lock time), so it never took part in the draw.
qy_lot_why_blocked_voided: This activity was cancelled or voided; no result was drawn.
qy_lot_mode_rank_hint: Draw the top N from the frozen roster. A ticket's rank depends on every other ticket, and all prizes are always awarded.
qy_lot_mode_prob_hint: Every ticket rolls once and wins whichever band it lands in. The result never depends on other players, and **nobody may win at all**.
qy_lot_mode_ball_hint: One draw for the whole round; players pick their own numbers and tiers are decided by how many red/blue balls match. Each tier's odds follow from the number pool by combinatorics - anyone can compute them.
qy_lot_ball_pool_hint_invalid: The number pool is invalid, so odds cannot be computed.
qy_lot_ball_series_option: {{title}} ({{redPick}} of {{redPool}} red · {{bluePick}} of {{bluePool}} blue · next is round {{issue}})
qy_lot_ball_series_hint: The number pool, the stake-to-pool share and the lifetime issuance cap all come from the series and cannot be overridden here. The pool never changes between rounds, so neither do the odds.
qy_lot_ball_series_manage_desc: Manage number pools, the pool that rolls over between rounds, and the lifetime issuance cap of each series.
qy_lot_ball_series_panel_note: Every lotto round belongs to a series. The number pool is fixed on the series and never changes between rounds, because a mutable number space means mutable odds.
qy_lot_ball_series_create_desc: The number pool and the issuance cap are frozen at creation - no endpoint can change them afterwards.
qy_lot_ball_series_confirm_desc: Once created, the number pool and the issuance cap are permanent. Please check them once more.
qy_lot_ball_series_close_desc: After closing, no further funding and no new rounds are possible, and **the rolled-over pool is forfeited**. The reason you enter is shown to participants.
qy_lot_ball_jackpot_odds: Jackpot (all red and blue matched): {{percent}}%, about 1 in {{odds}} tickets. The pool cannot be changed after creation - make sure this is the difficulty you want.
qy_lot_ball_odds_admin: This tier: {{percent}}%, about 1 in {{odds}} (computed from combinatorics)
qy_lot_ball_odds_local_note: The odds above are computed in your browser from the number pool by combinatorics - they are not a number handed down by the platform. This column requires no trust.
qy_lot_ball_share_series_hint: {{percent}}% of each round's stakes goes into the prize pool; the rest is the platform fee. This share is frozen into the commitment every round.
qy_lot_ball_share_hint: This tier takes {{percent}}% of the round's pool, split evenly among all winners of the tier.
qy_lot_ball_money_note: The spending bound of a lotto round is not "total prize amount": the floating part comes out of the round's pool. Publishing hard-checks that fixed spend + opening pool x total floating share <= opening pool, and refuses otherwise.
qy_lot_ball_multi_win_note: Lotto rounds never de-duplicate winners (every ticket wins on its own), because "the odds are exactly what combinatorics says" is the entire claim of this mode. Use the per-user entry cap to limit participation instead.
qy_lot_ball_issue_cap_hint: No matter how many rounds this series runs or how unlucky they are, the platform's cumulative net issuance stays under this number. No endpoint can change it after creation - it is the only loss gate a rollover game has.
qy_lot_ball_seed_quota_hint: Funded into the pool right away; you can top up later at any time, bounded by the lifetime issuance cap.
qy_lot_ball_fund_desc: Add quota to this series' prize pool. This is the only action that actively raises the platform's issuance ceiling, and it is audited.
qy_lot_ball_fund_over_cap: Exceeds this series' remaining headroom; the server will reject it.
qy_lot_ball_no_series_desc: Create one under "Lotto series" first: the number pool, the stake-to-pool share and the issuance cap are all defined there.
qy_lot_ball_pick_series_first: Pick a series in step 1 first - tier thresholds and odds are computed from its number pool.
qy_lot_ball_result_verify_note: The winning numbers are drawn from the public seed and are not part of the commitment. The fairness verification panel re-draws them in your own browser and compares them against the numbers published here, plus the tier of every winner; amounts are not recomputed (a floating prize depends on this round's pool and how many share the tier).
qy_lot_ball_no_tier: Your numbers did not meet any tier threshold - no prize this round.
qy_lot_ball_amount_not_local: The tier above was computed in your browser from the winning numbers and the published thresholds. The amount was not: a floating tier pays out of this round pool split among its winners, and neither number is part of this proof.
qy_lot_v_ball_series_required: A lotto round must belong to a series
qy_lot_v_ball_series_title: Series title is required and must be at most 60 characters
qy_lot_v_ball_pool_invalid: Invalid number pool: 2-36 red picking 1-8, 1-16 blue picking 1-2, and picks cannot exceed the pool size
qy_lot_v_ball_match_range: Match thresholds must fall within what the number pool allows
qy_lot_v_ball_match_zero: Every tier must require at least one matching ball, otherwise everyone wins it
qy_lot_v_ball_share_range: Pool share must be between 0 and 10000 basis points
qy_lot_v_ball_share_sum: Floating tiers' pool shares must not add up to more than 100%
qy_lot_v_ball_share_amount: A floating tier must have a fixed amount of 0 (the two forms are mutually exclusive)
qy_lot_v_ball_fixed_amount: A fixed tier needs both an amount and a share count
qy_lot_v_ball_budget_short: A fixed tier's budget (amount x count) must be at least the round's entry cap, otherwise an over-subscribed round dilutes some winners to 0 and they receive nothing
qy_lot_v_ball_unreachable: A tier's threshold is not stricter than a lower tier's, so the lower one can never be won. Smaller tier numbers must require more matches.
qy_lot_v_ball_cap_required: The lifetime issuance cap must be greater than 0
qy_lot_v_ball_seed_over_cap: Initial funding cannot exceed the lifetime issuance cap
qy_lot_text_no_commit_notice: The prize name, description and quantity entered the commitment hash at publish time and cannot be changed. The specific content you received was entered by an admin after the draw, so it is not covered by the commitment - it did not exist when the commitment was made.
qy_lot_finished_means_funds_only: "Finished" means all funds are settled, not that every prize has been handed over - text prizes are fulfilled manually and have no SLA.
qy_lot_unfulfill_warn: The plaintext cannot be taken back - the user may already have seen and used it. Undoing only corrects the record; both the fulfillment and the undo leave permanent history entries, and any superseded code is archived so it stays available in a dispute.
qy_lot_admin_reveal_audited: This action is audited; a reason of at least 4 characters is required
qy_tk_my_empty_desc: Submit a ticket if you run into a problem and we will get back to you.
qy_tk_new_desc: Describe what happened, when it happened, and what you have already tried.
qy_tk_field_title_ph: Summarize your problem in one line
qy_tk_field_priority_hint: Priority is a hint for triage; support may adjust it.
qy_tk_field_body_ph: Describe the issue in detail; error messages are welcome
qy_tk_reply_ph: Add details or answer support's question
qy_tk_closed_hint: This ticket is closed. Please open a new one if you still need help.
qy_tk_images_hint: Up to {{max}} images, {{mb}} MB each, JPEG / PNG / WebP
qy_tk_err_image_too_large_local: Image exceeds {{mb}} MB, please compress it
qy_tk_a_empty_desc: Try different filters, or wait for new tickets.
qy_tk_a_search_ph: Search by ticket no. or title
qy_tk_a_internal_toggle: Internal note (not visible to the customer)
qy_tk_a_internal_warning: Internal notes are never sent to the customer and do not change the ticket status.
qy_tk_a_closed_hint: This ticket is closed. Reopen it first to continue the conversation.
qy_err_tk_assignee_invalid: The assignee does not exist or is not an administrator
qy_err_tk_cooldown: Please wait a moment before submitting another ticket
qy_err_tk_reply_cooldown: You are replying too fast, please wait a moment
qy_err_tk_daily_limit: You have submitted too many tickets today
qy_err_tk_open_limit: Too many open tickets — please close some of them first
qy_err_tk_message_limit: This ticket has reached the message limit — please open a new one
qy_err_tk_closed: This ticket is closed — please open a new one if you still need help
qy_err_tk_illegal_transition: This action is not allowed in the current state
qy_err_tk_status_conflict: This ticket was updated by someone else — please refresh
qy_err_tk_image_disabled: Image upload is disabled on this site
qy_err_tk_image_type: Only JPEG / PNG / WebP images are accepted
qy_err_tk_image_not_found: Image not found or already used
qy_err_tk_image_too_many: Too many images for one message
qy_err_tk_image_pending_limit: You have unsent uploads — finish the current message first
qy_err_tk_image_quota: Your ticket images have filled your quota — close tickets you no longer need
qy_err_tk_image_purged: This image has been purged by the retention policy
qy_err_tk_image_store_failed: Failed to store the image, please try again
qy_aa_desc: These addresses are offered to users when they copy connection info or import into CC Switch from the API keys page. With none configured, the site's own address is used.
qy_aa_empty: No API address configured yet. Users will get the site's own address when copying connection info or importing into CC Switch.
qy_aa_form_desc: Name and note are for display only. Enter the host (and port) — no query string or fragment.
qy_aa_field_url_hint: Must start with http:// or https://. No credentials, query string, or fragment.
qy_aa_field_enabled_hint: Kept here when off, but users can no longer pick it.
qy_aa_order_dirty: Order changed — click Save order to apply it for users.
qy_aa_delete_desc: Users will no longer see it when picking an API address. Configs already copied or imported are unaffected.
qy_aa_pick_desc: The address you pick goes into the copied connection info you paste into CC Switch and similar clients.
qy_aa_pick_desc_cc_switch: The address you pick becomes the endpoint in the CC Switch config. The config dialog opens once you have chosen.
qy_err_aa_name_required: Enter a name for the address
qy_err_aa_url_scheme: The API address must start with http:// or https://
qy_err_aa_url_credentials: The API address must not contain credentials
qy_err_aa_url_extra: The API address must not contain a query string or fragment — host and port only
qy_err_aa_url_invalid: The API address is not a valid URL
qy_err_aa_limit: The API address limit has been reached
qy_err_aa_not_found: This API address no longer exists — another admin may have deleted it
qy_err_aa_order_stale: The list changed under you — refresh and reorder again
qy_group_matrix_desc: Rows are user groups (which tier a person belongs to); columns are model groups (which pool of channels a request is routed to). A cell holds the ratio for that pair; a dashed cell means people in that tier cannot select that pool at all.
qy_group_matrix_namespace_note: Both axes share one underlying string namespace, so the same name can appear on each side meaning different things. This page always keeps them in separate axes: rows are always "who", columns are always "which channel pool".
qy_group_matrix_col_no_channels: This model group has no enabled channels; granting it opens an empty pool.
qy_group_matrix_ratio_inherit_hint: Leave blank to inherit this model group's base ratio of {{ratio}}. To make it free you must type 0 yourself.
qy_group_matrix_ratio_zero_hint: 0 means explicitly free, which is not the same as leaving it blank: 0 bills at zero, blank falls back to the model group's base ratio. Ratios and selectability are two independent records: a ratio can still be charging on a cell that is not selectable (unmanaged rows, shadow mode, the diagonal), so this field stays editable.
qy_group_matrix_saved: Saved; both the ratios and the selectable list are in effect
qy_group_matrix_save_needs_preview: This draft revokes access or changes ratios, so you must preview the impact before saving: revoking makes a batch of users start getting 403s immediately, and a repriced pair starts billing at the new rate the second the save succeeds.
qy_group_matrix_save_partial_ratio_only: Half applied: ratios were written, the selectable list was not
